summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on diagnostics generation-4 PR #392 exact head b21a0ecac4dc67900f004527291ebcb4daeea519: diagnosticsRoot() uses one FindFirstChild(DIAGNOSTICS_ROOT_NAME) and does not reject duplicate same-named diagnostics roots, so standalone capture() can validate/count one owned readout tree while silently ignoring a second stale/owned diagnostics root.
evidence: PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.diagnosticsRoot() resolves only model:FindFirstChild(DIAGNOSTICS_ROOT_NAME), validates that single Instance, and returns it without enumerating/rejecting another direct child with the same diagnostics root name
Roblox Instance children may share names, so a second UNRENDERED_PhysicsLabDiagnostics Folder can coexist under the lab model

capture() derives enabled/readout completeness/diagnosticInstanceCount only from the one Folder returned by diagnosticsRoot(), allowing an extra same-named owned/stale root to be omitted from the published snapshot
disable() can eventually detect a leftover duplicate through its post-destroy capture, but that does not make standalone capture() fail closed on the malformed physical state
Existing readout-completeness and atomicity tests validate the tree beneath one resolved root and do not pin duplicate-root rejection

Bounded fix: enumerate direct children named DIAGNOSTICS_ROOT_NAME, reject more than one before returning, preserve unrelated-root ownership/class guards, and add a pure source regression. No Studio/viewport evidence is needed or claimed
